author: reek
body: Stage 4b/5 soundness tripwire: a structural-induction proof whose step case offers `Refl` where the goal is not reflexive must be rejected. For `add n Zero === n` the Succ case subgoal normalizes to `Succ (add k Zero) === Succ k`; that holds only via the inductive hypothesis `add k Zero === k` (discharged by `cong ih`), NOT by reflexivity. Offering `Refl` there asserts `add k Zero` and `k` are definitionally equal, which they are not, so the subgoal check rejects with CDX2001. If induction ever accepted this, it would prove a FALSE theorem for every non-base constructor -- the soundness tripwire.
